title: 9/11: The Legacy
description: More than 72 million children woke up the morning of Sept. 11, 2001, to what seemed like an ordinary Tuesday; in the end, eight lost their lives and more than 3,000 lost their parents.

title: 9/11: The Pentagon
description: The story of what happened inside the Pentagon in the minutes after a hijacked airliner crashed into the building as part of the largest coordinated terror attack on American soil, as told by the men and women who lived it.

title: Road to 9/11
description:
S01 E01 — Part 1: Brooklyn Jihad (1990-1995)
While investigating the assassination of a rabbi in 1990, agents discover a Brooklyn-based terrorist cell with connections to Osama bin Laden; in 1993, cell members succeed in setting off a bomb in the World Trade Center, killing six people.

title: Road to 9/11
description:
S01 E02 — Part 2: The Bin Ladens (1995-2000)
Clinton administration officials react to the rise in jihadi terror; operations are planned targeting Osama bin Laden resulting in near misses; a profile of bin Laden emerges through interview footage with him and commentary from people who knew him.

title: Road to 9/11
description:
S01 E03 — Part 3: The Days of Terror (2000-2003)
A portrait of Khalid Sheikh Mohammed, the mastermind of the Sept. 11 attacks; a look at the men recruited to carry out the attacks, including their backgrounds and training; an examination of missed signals in Washington, D.C., prior to the attacks.

title: Days That Shaped America: September 11th
description: The largest terror attack in United States history left images seared into everyone's conscience that will never be forgotten; for those caught in the middle, the memories are as strong today as they were in 2001.

title: History's Greatest Mysteries
description:
S07 E19 — The Hunt for the Anthrax Killer

title: Navy SEALs: America's Secret Warriors
description:
S01 E01 — Part 1
The history of the SEALs' predecessors in World War II and the Korean War and their evolution into elite warriors, fighting in the jungles of Vietnam and executing secret missions in Panama and Grenada; the formation of SEAL Team 6.

title: Navy SEALs: America's Secret Warriors
description:
S01 E02 — Part 2
The SEALs become the tip of the spear in the War on Terror, executing daily raids in Afghanistan and Iraq as well as high-profile missions, such as the rescue of Capt. Richard Phillips from pirates and the raid on Osama bin Laden's compound.
